name: factory
description: A role-based software factory over wayfinding: a lead plus seven role agents that build one wayfinder slice end to end, talking through per-item message files, each with private craft memory, on one branch and worktree per item. One-way doors reach the person as plain-language decision cards.
domain: Building software end to end through role agents: requirements, architecture, implementation, verification, security review, delivery and documentation.
